data.desc: VTEX (NYSE: VTEX ) is the AI-native commerce suite designed for CIOs and CEOs, focused on driving operational efficiency. Evolving from software into a connected platform, VTEX unifies a multi-product ecosystem-comprising a Commerce platform (VTEX Commerce Platform), an Ads platform (VTEX Ads Platform), and an AI conversational platform (VTEX CX Platform)-to deliver solutions such as B2C Omnichannel, B2B commerce, agent-assisted customer service, WhatsApp Store, distributed OMS, marketplace enablement, and advertising solutions. This architecture enables brands and retailers to eliminate friction, orchestrate operations, and accelerate profitable growth. Trusted by approximately 2,200 customers-including Carrefour, Colgate, OBI, Stanley Black & Decker, KitchenAid, Whirlpool, and Electrolux-across 44 countries, VTEX brings the best of Brazilian engineering to the global market.
